# Poisson GEE multivariate/rescaling independent references

Pre-kernel development fixtures; **not evidence of a native implementation**.
Generated by `examples/mma23p1pannonlin/native_poisson_gee_reference.R` with
R4.6.2 and gee4.13.30, using the existing inspectable synthetic12-firm
`tests/fixtures/mma23_conditional_fe/source.asc` counts/first predictor.
No publisher records or native result is an oracle.

- `multivariate`:60 observations,12 balanced groups of5; intercept/x1 plus
  independent deterministic x2=`cos(id*1.17+period*.71)+(period-3)/3`.
- `rescaled`: identical data but x2 multiplied by1e-6. All coefficient/SE/CI
  and full covariance natural-unit rescaling identities pass across R fits.

These are numerical design controls, not additional book regressors. Two
all-zero groups remain; rho≈.284612145133617, working variance fixed1,
legacy normalized Pearson correlation and separate G/(G−1) group sandwich.
R gee uses explicit pooled starts, v4.4compat=TRUE, tol1e-12/maxiter100;
its modern moment convention is not the target.

Each case has `input.csv`,66 `reference.csv` fields (metadata, both sets of
coefficient/SE/z/p/CI, both full3x3 covariance matrices and slope-Wald/p), all
60 `predictions.csv` records, all12 raw-coordinate3-vector `scores.csv` and
`version.txt`. All numeric artifacts are explicitly17 significant digits.

Independent dense R per-group V/derivative/score/bread matrices are solved at
the package fit, with RMS basis only for conditioning; full raw-parameter
covariances agree with R package matrices within relative1e-9. Scores satisfy
the independently evaluated equation gate. GEE bread is expected sensitivity,
not the observed derivative/Hessian of the residual-dependent score.

Regenerate only into fresh directories and compare before replacing:

```sh
ref=$(mktemp -d)
for case in multivariate rescaled; do
  Rscript examples/mma23p1pannonlin/native_poisson_gee_reference.R \
    tests/fixtures/mma23_conditional_fe/source.asc "$ref/$case" "$case"
done
```

Optional R gee is development-only. Archive4.13-30 SHA256
`65f9fe9c906a200bd89a6c053e8c33cce356b626a0de639cc69d804bc3326b95`.
See [native contract/reference setup](../../../../../examples/mma23p1pannonlin/native_poisson_gee.md)
for bounds/tolerances and the verified host-specific FLIBS installation trap;
no production R/Fortran/dependency is added. This does not claim implemented
native GEE, unbalanced moments, automatic bootstrap, historical optimizer parity
or whole textbook coverage.
